cad64.capacity_basis: Retained scene model parameters. CAD horizontal columns are evidenced; four vertical levels and vendor identity are not surveyed.
cad64.path_basis: Presentation motion path fitted inside the retained scene footprint, not surveyed drive-chain dimensions.
cad64.cart_grouping_basis: Source CAD separate caster-supported frames: 2C9A89 has 4+4 columns per side; 2C9AE5 has 5+5+5. Heights retain the existing scene interpretation; not the separate 96-bin manual model.

cad120.capacity_basis: Retained scene model parameters. CAD horizontal columns are evidenced; four vertical levels and vendor identity are not surveyed.
cad120.path_basis: Presentation motion path fitted inside the retained scene footprint, not surveyed drive-chain dimensions.
cad120.cart_grouping_basis: Source CAD separate caster-supported frames: 2C9A89 has 4+4 columns per side; 2C9AE5 has 5+5+5. Heights retain the existing scene interpretation; not the separate 96-bin manual model.

axis_contract: FBX source metres CAD +Y; UE import makes X=100*x,Y=-100*y,Z=100*z. Profiles already use UE local cm.
dynamic_axes: Local +X is CCW path tangent; local +Y is inward left normal. Tray is centred; no outward assumption.
safety: No decorative collision; reuse grouped instancing; simulation actors manage bounded shared updates.
